theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_graph_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∃ δE : ℝ, 0 < δE ∧ ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ δE → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → ∀ (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (Ω : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u Ω → q '' graphOver u Ω ⊆ V.support ∩ ball 0 ρ → (∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ Ω → ∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ x in A, g (q (graphPoint x (u x))) ≤ ∫⁻ y in q '' graphOver u A, g y ∂V.weight) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), V.tangentProj (q (graphPoint x (u x))) = (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ u x v)))).starProjection) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (V.weight (closedBall (q (graphPoint x (u x))) s))⁻¹ * ∫⁻ y in closedBall (q (graphPoint x (u x))) s, ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (V.tangentProj y - V.tangentProj (q (graphPoint x (u x))))) ∂V.weight) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
